name: gmail-mcp
description: Read, search, triage, draft and SEND email from your own Gmail account. Your credentials stay on your machine.

client_id.title: OAuth client ID
client_id.description: From the OAuth client you created in your own Google Cloud project. See docs/setup-google-cloud.md. Leave all three fields empty to resolve the credential from your working directory instead: the nearest .env (walking up to the repo root), then $GMAIL_MCP_CREDENTIALS, then ~/.config/pappcorn-gmail-mcp/credentials.json.

client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: From the same OAuth client. Stored in your OS keychain, never written to disk by this plugin.

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Minted by scripts/mint-token.mjs after you log in as the account you want the assistant to use. Grants access to that one mailbox only.
